params.name: $filter
params.description: OData filter expression. Field names are case-sensitive and must match $metadata.

params.name: $select
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return.

params.name: $expand
params.description: Comma-separated list of related resources to inline-expand.

params.name: $orderby
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields with optional asc / desc modifiers.

params.name: $top
params.description: Maximum number of records to return. Default 10, maximum 1000 (300000 for key-only queries).

params.name: $skip
params.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

params.name: $count
params.description: When true, includes the total count of matching records in @odata.count.

params.name: $apply
params.description: OData apply transformation (e.g. groupby) — max 10000 result rows.

params.name: Replication
params.description: When true, enables high-volume replication mode for datasets exceeding 1M rows.

params.name: PrettyEnums
params.description: When true, returns human-readable enumeration values instead of internal codes.

items.docs: Returns Property records matching the supplied OData query options. Supports $filter, $select, $expand, $orderby, $top (max 1000, or 300000 for key-only), $skip, $count, $apply=groupby (max 10000), Replication=true for large datasets, and PrettyEnums=true.
